budget_disclosure: Static frontend settings were fixed in advance for CORAL (diagonal shrinkage 0.1, ridge 0.001), not source-selected. Existing official RIFT candidates used public calibration query labels for epoch pick; this package uses a sealed fixed-final EMA checkpoint and does not replace those official candidates. No remote push or EvalAI submission has been performed.
method_description: Same-capacity static-RIFT control: one already-trained static EMA checkpoint; only the pre-local_conv neural calibration changes. Network keeps raw-input processing; no WF smoothing is added. Frontend is per-session diag-z mapping target raw support onto pooled source raw-support mean/std. Same frozen network weights as the static+CORAL sibling. Local standard R2=0.271371 (not official). New linear baselines used source-only hyperparameter selection (80/20 chronological per source recording, 21-native-bin gap). Query labels did not enter fit or selection. Existing official RIFT candidates used public calibration query labels for epoch pick; that is a different selection budget. Fixed-final RIFT rows are local diagnostics only and do not replace existing official RIFT candidates.
